name: Tricaine
aliases: 3-(Ethoxycarbonyl)aniline, 3-Aminobenzoic acid ethyl ester, AI3-02743, Ethyl m-aminobenzoate, m-Aminobenzoic acid, ethyl ester, m-Ethoxycarbonylaniline, metacaine

uses.text: Tricaine mesylate (Tricaine methanesulfonate, TMS, MS-222, Syncaine, Tricaine-S), is white powder used for anesthesia, sedation, or euthanasia of fish and amphibians. TMS is the only anesthetic licensed in the United States for fin fish that are intended for human consumption. Sodium bicarbonate can be used to buffer the solution to a pH range of 6.5-7.5.
